title: FRIDAY held-out speech evaluation set: catalogue of candidate public sources, no items yet

sources.name: FLEURS (Google), Hindi hi_in and English en_us
sources.note: Read Wikipedia-derived sentences, about 12 hours per language, unprocessed recordings. Not downloaded here.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice, Hindi and English
sources.note: Distributed through Mozilla Data Collective since October 2025 (terms accepted there). The release version and the Hindi size are unverified. Keep each client_id in one split.

sources.name: Kathbath (AI4Bharat), Hindi read speech
sources.note: The dataset card lists cc-by-4.0 while its licensing text says CC0 for the packaging; the stricter CC-BY-4.0 is used until that is settled.

sources.name: IndicVoices (AI4Bharat), Hindi read, extempore and conversational speech
sources.note: Access needs accepting the dataset conditions and a Hugging Face token. Mostly extempore and conversational speech, the closest public match to how the owner talks.
